races.name: PwC Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
KIMI DE MAI went close at Roscommon last time, where a mistake at the last may have cost her victory, and, back down in trip, she is taken to open her account. Impressive Galway bumper winner Brickfield Belle is feared most, with Silk Buds also respected after making the frame in bumpers.

  1. KIMI DE MAI (FR)
  2. BRICKFIELD BELLE (IRE)
  3. SILK BUDS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Wire Products (C & G) Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
THINKITDONTJINXIT was runner-up in back-to-back Thurles bumpers and, despite disappointing when last seen in that sphere, looks the type to come into his own over hurdles, with Global Submission the main danger if ready to go on return and progressive maiden Approval very much respected.

  1. THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE)
  2. GLOBAL SUBMISSION
  3. APPROVAL

races.name: Limerick Show Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A competitive race could see the unexposed TELL ME SEE open his account on just his second handicap start. Humble Brag and Zambezi Moon head the list of dangers, with Cool Native and Jaadil others to consider.

  1. TELL ME SEE (IRE)
  2. HUMBLE BRAG (IRE)
  3. ZAMBEZI MOON (IRE)

races.name: John Thomas McNamara Series (Q.R.) Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DUCE BIGALOW arrives on the back of an encouraging return and may still have more to offer as a stayer after just 3 starts at this trip. Just For One is likely to prove the main danger if building on his recent comeback and staying 3m as well as his pedigree suggests, while Haveanothertry and Run For The Border are also respected.

  1. DUCE BIGALOW (IRE)
  2. JUST FOR ONE (IRE)
  3. HAVEANOTHERTRY (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports JT McNamara Munster National Handicap Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
UHAVEMEINSTITCHES gets the nod in another ultra-competitive renewal of this race. A Wave of The Sea could well make it a 1-2 for JP McManus, with very useful novice chaser Bossofthebrownies also feared. Weveallbeencaught, Iceberg Theory and Sportinthepark are other notable contenders.

  1. UHAVEMEINSTITCHES (IRE)
  2. A WAVE OF THE SEA (IRE)
  3. BOSSOFTHEBROWNIES (IRE)

races.name: Boyle Sports Jt Mcnamara Munster National Handicap Chase (Grade 3)
STL Logistics Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
HASHTAG PRETENDER has few miles on the clock over fences for his age and can gain compensation for a promising run last time. Zurich looks sure to be thereabouts on return, while Miners Bridge has each-way claims.

  1. HASHTAG PRETENDER (FR)
  2. ZURICH (FR)
  3. MINERS BRIDGE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
Hard to rule out any of these. FUTURE PROSPECT has been knocking on the door over fences, and her experience may just give her the edge over interesting chasing debutant Echoing Silence.

  1. FUTURE PROSPECT (IRE)
  2. ECHOING SILENCE (IRE)
  3. MISS FOURIE (IRE)

races.name: Michael And Olivia Watson Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TOMMY PICKLES and Edelak are closely matched on their best form but the former is the confident selection with Edelak having plenty to prove all of a sudden.

  1. TOMMY PICKLES (IRE)
  2. EDELAK (IRE)
  3. ROCK ARMOUR (IRE)

races.name: Celebrating 40 Years Of Vickers Bookmakers Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Not a deep race and last-time-out winner STAY HOPEFUL is taken to follow up from course specialist Tom Creen. Illogical Logic is another to consider.

  1. STAY HOPEFUL (IRE)
  2. TOM CREEN (IRE)
  3. ILLOGICAL LOGIC (FR)

races.name: Roflow Specialist Ventilation & Dehumidification 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Irish raider CODGER'S ROCK makes most appeal on the back of his Clonmel second. Can't Resist It showed enough last season to think he should also be in the mix, whilst Lady Boujee rates as an interesting hurdles newcomer for Dan Skelton.

  1. CODGER'S ROCK (IRE)
  2. CAN'T RESIST IT
  3. LADY BOUJEE (FR)

races.name: Bet Vickers Durham National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Difficult to rule any of this lot out but the vote goes to FEVER DREAM, who shaped as if ahead of his mark when scrambling home at Warwick last month and Christian Williams's 8-y-o shouldn't have any issues back over a marathon trip. The form of Dexperts Opinion's latest Worcester success couldn't be working out much better, so he heads up the opposition, with the progressive Ki Woo rounding off the shortlist on reappearance.

  1. FEVER DREAM (IRE)
  2. DEXPERTS OPINION (IRE)
  3. KI WOO (FR)

races.name: Vickers Bookmakers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
C&D winner ZAMOND ticks plenty of boxes and is fancied to resume winning ways. In-form Curious Mrs Fox may give him most to think about, with lightly-raced 6-y-o Cadillac Ranch best of the rest.

  1. ZAMOND (FR)
  2. CURIOUS MRS FOX
  3. CADILLAC RANCH (IRE)

races.name: Download The www.betvickers.com App Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DOUBLE DIGITS should come on plenty for his recent reappearance and is taken to add to last year's win over fences here. Gambino is feared on handicap debut for the Skeltons, while Klitschko can go well in his bid for third C&D success.

  1. DOUBLE DIGITS
  2. GAMBINO (IRE)
  3. KLITSCHKO

races.name: MW Civils & Groundworks Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PARKSIDE LILY receives over a stone from penalised winner Going On so Dan Skelton's filly looks the percentage call given the yard's terrific strike rate in bumpers.

  1. PARKSIDE LILY (IRE)
  2. GOING ON (IRE)
  3. MYSTERLAND (FR)

races.name: Leopardstown Golf, Padel And Range Maiden
races.verdict:
Dermot Weld might hold the key here, with his three-time runner-up SUNATIA fancied to finally go one place better. Well-bred stablemate Rhapsodic is of serious interest on her belated debut, whilst King of Sparta would be of interest if back to the form of his second here late last season.

  1. SUNATIA (FR)
  2. RHAPSODIC
  3. KING OF SPARTA (IRE)

races.name: Bahrain Turf Club Knockaire Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
KING CUAN was most impressive on return at the Curragh and it may pay to keep the faith on his first start over 1m. Faiyum is feared most in receipt of weight from the field, while stable debutant Dublin's Knight needs a close look in the market on belated return.

  1. KING CUAN
  2. FAIYUM
  3. DUBLIN'S KNIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Nord Anglia International School Dublin Foxrock Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
PLAYIN COOL is still low mileage and can build on his encouraging effort in the Irish Cambridgeshire to land this prize. Majestic King arrives in great form and is also shortlisted, alongside the hat-trick seeking Uncle Goalie and recent Listowel winner Morehampton.

  1. PLAYIN COOL (IRE)
  2. MAJESTIC KING (IRE)
  3. UNCLE GOALIE (IRE)

races.name: Trigo Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
An open-looking renewal but plenty of eyes will be on COME WHAT MAY, who couldn't have been much more impressive first time up at the Curragh just over 3 weeks ago and Aidan O'Brien's colt falls firmly into the 'could be anything' category. He can get the better of Snellen, who has been off since a below-par effort here in mid-July but is the type to bounce back. The lightly-raced Hazdann may emerge as best of the remainder.

  1. COME WHAT MAY (IRE)
  2. SNELLEN (IRE)
  3. HAZDANN (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Festival Tickets On Sale Now Handicap
races.verdict:
GREAT MOVER looked a shade unlucky when third behind a couple of next-time-out winners at Listowel last month so is taken to make amends. This does look competitive, though, with Rest Your Mind and Spacebound heading the dangers.

  1. GREAT MOVER (IRE)
  2. REST YOUR MIND (IRE)
  3. SPACEBOUND

races.name: Bahrain Turf Club October Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
The vote goes to SIR JEREMY, who's been catching the eye in similar events of late. Thatwilldoso and Truth Be Told head the dangers, with Sky Captain, Handani and Latin America also likely to play a hand in this wide-open handicap.

  1. SIR JEREMY (IRE)
  2. THATWILLDOSO (IRE)
  3. TRUTH BE TOLD (IRE)

races.name: Watch Every Irish Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
A fiendishly-difficult finale to solve with cases able to be made for several. The vote goes to ZARAAHMANDO, who has made the frame 7 times this season and Andrew Slattery's 4-y-o can belatedly open his 2026 account. Bundle of Interest got closer than previously this season last time and now reunited with Billy Lee, she could provide most resistance. Bay of Dreams and the selection's stablemate Queen Aethelflaed can fight out minor honours.

  1. ZARAAHMANDO (IRE)
  2. BUNDLE OF INTEREST (IRE)
  3. BAY OF DREAMS (IRE)
